landing.title: Publish the work. Compare real offers.
landing.lead: One structured place for construction and repair work in Georgia. You publish the requirement, verified providers submit comparable offers, and the tender closes on your deadline at the lowest price.
landing.previewFoot: At the deadline the lowest valid offer is selected automatically and the agreement is recorded.
landing.previewEmpty: No tender is open for offers right now.
landing.privacyNote: Client and full spec unlock with provider access
landing.noOpenTenders: No tenders are open for offers right now. New requirements are published every day.
landing.howLead: Every tender follows the same recorded path from published requirement to reviewed completion.
landing.clientStep1: Describe the work in a structured form
landing.clientStep1Body: Category, scope, materials, site conditions, schedule and deadline — so offers stay comparable.
landing.clientStep2: Receive offers while your identity stays private
landing.clientStep2Body: Only providers with paid access see your full requirement and contact details.
landing.clientStep3Body: The lowest valid offer is selected automatically and the agreement is recorded on the platform.
landing.clientStep4Body: Reviews are bound to the finished job, so ratings reflect real work only.
landing.providerStep1Body: Relevant tenders reach you as they open, filtered to the work you actually do.
landing.providerStep2Body: Paid access opens the full specification, attachments and client contact.
landing.providerStep3Body: You see the current lowest price, so you know exactly where your bid stands.
landing.providerStep4Body: Verified completions and job-bound reviews compound into a reputation that wins the next tender.
landing.trustLead: Every mechanism on the platform exists to make offers comparable and reputation earned. Administrators manage accounts, content and payments — they never choose a winner or arbitrate a dispute between users.
landing.trust1Body: Construction-specific fields instead of free text, so two offers can be compared line by line.
landing.trust2Body: Client identity and documents stay hidden until a provider unlocks the tender.
landing.trust3Body: When the clock runs out the lowest valid offer wins automatically. No quiet renegotiation.
landing.trust4Body: Only a verified completed engagement can produce a review, on either side.
landing.quotesNote: Every review here is bound to a verified completed engagement.
landing.quotesEmpty: No reviews have been published yet. The first one arrives when an engagement is completed and confirmed by both sides.
landing.ctaBody: Clients publish at no cost. Providers pay only for access to the tenders they want to win.
